consumer: The status panel renderer that reads the avatar's stamina/pain scalars from the snapshot to SHOW them; it asks 'what are the avatar's current stamina and pain numbers?' and no engine condition/mission/dialogue check evaluates a yes/no from them.
scope: only the avatar's own scalar status values (the player character itself), not nearby entities and not a map region
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) writes ctx.u.get_stamina() and ctx.u.get_pain() straight from the engine getters into the snapshot JSON with no formatting, filtering, lag, or colour/threshold transform, so the authority is the raw scalar world state itself.
divergence: The avatar sprints and stamina drains from 10000 to 3000 (or pain rises after an injury); a wrong answer that reports a stale/cached number or a re-derived proxy instead of the live get_stamina()/get_pain() value is exposed against the live scalar.
